identity.title: Kyurem VS the Sacred Swordsman: Keldeo / Meloetta's Dazzling Recital Music Collection

leadText: Kyurem VS the Sacred Swordsman: Keldeo / Meloetta's Dazzling Recital Music Collection (Japanese: ２０１２年劇場版ポケットモンスター　ベストウイッシュ　「キュレムＶＳ聖剣士　ケルディオ」＆「メロエッタのキラキラリサイタル」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the fifteenth movie and Meloetta's Dazzling Recital. It was released in Japan on August 3, 2012.
plainText:
Kyurem VS the Sacred Swordsman: Keldeo / Meloetta's Dazzling Recital Music Collection (Japanese: ２０１２年劇場版ポケットモンスター　ベストウイッシュ　「キュレムＶＳ聖剣士　ケルディオ」＆「メロエッタのキラキラリサイタル」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the fifteenth movie and Meloetta's Dazzling Recital. It was released in Japan on August 3, 2012.

Castle of Ice (氷の城)
